synopsis: The glossary identifies NVIDIA A40 and A100 as data-center graphics cards [f16199]. Chapter 6 reports that WeatherDiffusion (2022/2023) takes 20.52 seconds per 640 × 432 image on one A40, compared with 0.88 seconds for a non-diffusion network [f4950]. The glossary repeats the 20.52-second A40 result, describing the model as a diffusion weather-editing network [f16201]. Chapter 6 uses these weather-removal models as a cost proxy, so the reported runtime is proxy evidence rather than a direct measurement of the target simulation workload [f4950].

relations.note: Both report 20.52 seconds per image on one A40; Chapter 6 adds resolution and comparator.
